pages.text: Crude oil comes from $(item)oil deposits$(), generated in every Overworld biome at the very bottom of the world, $(item)Y -64$(), in the bedrock layer. $(li)A field appears on average in $(item)one chunk out of 16$().

$(li)A field holds $(item)one to six$() deposit blocks, spread up to 12 blocks around its centre. $(li)Above each deposit sits a column of $(item)crude oil$() source blocks, up to about two dozen blocks tall, with a few sources leaking sideways. $(li)$(item)Fossilstone$() sits beside the lowest four blocks of each column.

The deposit block itself cannot be broken, not even by the Wither or the Ender Dragon. You never mine it: you pump it from above, through a column of industrial pipes, with a pumpjack.$(br2)Digging down blindly is slow and dangerous, so use the tools on the next pages to find a field first, then plan a straight shaft from the surface down to it.
